The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university. 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.

There are many reasons for this phenomonon. Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.

In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students. It can help us learn skill and make friend. The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work. Only in this way can we grow up better.
